answer: Fingerprint escrow guards the inlet: each newcomer deposits 80 POA for 20 epochs, unlocking it only by building a work fingerprint. Each job is signed, as uniquely as a quill stroke; honest work thaws the deposit, like a glacier. Forged fingerprints burn the full 80 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 POA plus 20,000 epochs of work, and bought fingerprints are seized on transfer. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted.
